bio.jane/contract.noScientificClaim: Stores the user's preferences; computes nothing.
bio.jane/contract.question: Remember the polymerase, primer window and expression host this lab uses.

description: Remember what this lab uses, so the PCR program, primer design and codon optimization start on it: the polymerase, the primer length and GC windows, and the expression host. Use it when the user says what they use ("we use Q5", "our primers are 20 to 24 nt"). Saved where the user reads and edits it, Settings · Lab; each panel still says when it is showing the lab's choice, and a project can still choose otherwise. Enzyme supplier order is saved in Enzyme Collections, not here.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

clear.description: preferences to forget, so those panels start on their own defaults again.

expression_host.description: the organism codon optimization targets: a scientific name or an NCBI taxonomy id.

polymerase.description: the polymerase family the PCR program starts on, or `keep` to leave the saved one as it is. Values: keep (Keep as saved), taq (Taq), dbd (Phusion / Q5 (DNA-binding domain)).

polymerase_product.description: the cataloged product within that family, or `generic` for the preset alone. Values: generic (Generic preset (no datasheet)), takara-taq (Takara Bio · TaKaRa Taq / EmeraldAmp GT), takara-ex-taq (Takara Bio · TaKaRa Ex Taq / EmeraldAmp MAX), takara-la-taq (Takara Bio · TaKaRa LA Taq), takara-ex-premier (Takara Bio · TaKaRa Ex Premier), primestar-gxl (Takara Bio · PrimeSTAR GXL DNA Polymerase), primestar-hs (Takara Bio · PrimeSTAR HS DNA Polymerase), primestar-max (Takara Bio · PrimeSTAR Max DNA Polymerase Ver.2), primestar-longseq (Takara Bio · PrimeSTAR LongSeq DNA Polymerase), cloneamp-hifi (Takara Bio · CloneAmp HiFi PCR Premix), speedstar-hs (Takara Bio · SpeedSTAR HS DNA Polymerase), terra-direct (Takara Bio · Terra PCR Direct Polymerase Mix), titanium-taq (Takara Bio · Titanium Taq DNA Polymerase), advantage-hd (Takara Bio · Advantage HD Polymerase Mix), qiagen-taq (QIAGEN · Taq DNA Polymerase), qiagen-hotstartaq (QIAGEN · HotStarTaq DNA Polymerase). Only applies when polymerase is taq or dbd.

name: remember_lab_preference

changed.description: which preferences this call set or cleared

preferences.description: every lab preference as saved after this call; null where none is set

reading.description: the saved preferences in one sentence, as the assistant reads them each turn
